name: Dungeon Spoils opened below the lowest pool level gives a lowest-level item (#8541)
contract: #8541: a level 10 character used Dungeon Spoils (2021814) after Ragefire Chasm and nothing happened. The bag has
no level requirement, but every item of its vanilla dungeon pool requires level 13 or more, so the level-scaled
pick found no candidate. Opened at level 10 the spoils are now used up and put exactly one item of the lowest
required level in the pool (13) in the bags.

steps.label: CONTROL: p1 holds one Dungeon Spoils
p1 opens the spoils at level 10
p1 no longer holds the opened spoils
The spoils put exactly one of their items in p1's bags
It is an item of the lowest required level in the pool (13)
